commands.summary: Change one dimension's value or tolerance and regenerate; Creo takes back a value the model cannot regenerate with.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --id
flags.summary: The dimension's name, such as d12.

flags.name: --length
flags.summary: The new value of a linear, radius or diameter dimension.

flags.name: --angle
flags.summary: The new value of an angular dimension.

flags.name: --plus
flags.summary: With --minus: the upper deviation of a plus-minus tolerance.

flags.name: --minus
flags.summary: With --plus: the lower deviation, as a positive amount.

flags.name: --symmetric
flags.summary: A symmetric tolerance of plus or minus this much.

flags.name: --upper
flags.summary: With --lower: the upper limit itself.

flags.name: --lower
flags.summary: With --upper: the lower limit itself.

flags.name: --fit
flags.summary: An ISO 286 fit: capitals for a hole (H7), small letters for a shaft (g6).

flags.name: --basic
flags.summary: Make it a basic dimension, the exact value a geometric tolerance refers to.

flags.name: --nominal
flags.summary: Remove its tolerance.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Extrude a sketch into one feature, adding or removing material, and regenerate; a sketch that is not fully defined is refused.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --name
flags.summary: The new feature's name: a letter, then letters, digits or _, 31 at most.

flags.name: --sketch
flags.summary: The sketch: plane, x_axis, references, entities, constraints and named dimensions, inline or a file.

plane.description: The sketch plane: a datum such as TOP, a face such as BASE/end, or surface:<id>.

x_axis.description: The model axis the sketch's x runs along; it must lie in the plane. y is the plane's normal crossed with x.

references.description: Datum planes or planar faces across the sketch plane, projected to dimension and constrain to.

name.description: The dimension's name in Creo; dimension update takes it.

measure.description: An entity's own size: body.width, body.height, body.corner_radius, hole.diameter, rim.length.

value_mm.description: For from and to: the distance, its sign the side of from along the sketch axis.

flags.name: --depth
flags.summary: How far to extrude; with --symmetric, split to both sides.

flags.name: --depth-name
flags.summary: A name for the depth dimension, such as BODY_HEIGHT.

flags.name: --through-all
flags.summary: Through the whole part, for a cut.

flags.name: --to
flags.summary: Up to this plane or face: a datum name, a face such as BASE/end, or surface:<id>.

flags.name: --symmetric
flags.summary: Extrude half of --depth to each side of the sketch plane.

flags.name: --direction
flags.summary: The model axis to extrude along, such as +z; the plane's normal by default.

flags.name: --remove
flags.summary: Remove material (a cut) instead of adding it.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Hollow the part into one shell feature with walls of one thickness, open at the faces named; regenerate.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --name
flags.summary: The new feature's name, such as SHELL.

flags.name: --thickness
flags.summary: The wall thickness, measured inward.

flags.name: --thickness-name
flags.summary: A name for the thickness dimension, such as WALL.

flags.name: --remove
flags.summary: The faces left open, separated by ;: such as BASE/start, BASE/side[+x] or surface:41. Without it the shell is closed.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

flags.name: --edges
